story: The first grand depart on French soil since 2021 in Lille saw a two rider break with Benjamin Thomas taking the first polka dot jersey. 17 kilometers from the finish Visma - Lease a Bike initiated a move for echelons which a couple GC-contenders (Roglic, Evenepoel) missed. Jasper Philipsen finished off a tremendous lead-out to win the sprint of a 33-rider group.
